source("_data.R")
library(knitr)

standings %>%
  select(
    Participant        = user,
    Correct     = correct,
    Total       = total,
    `Win %`     = pct,
    `Base $`    = base_dollars,
    `Bonus $`   = bonus_dollars,
    `Missed $`  = missed_dollars,
    `Total $`   = total_dollars
  ) %>%
  kable()
